newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes easier on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes easier on dollar demand.

text.p: A rise in the demand for the U.S. currency, spurred by the reopening of international markets, forced the Bangladesh taka to finish weaker at 43.7500/7600 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday, dealers said.
This compares with the previous close at 43.7500/7520.
Dealers said softening of the call money rates also helped the dollar in the market that reopened after Sunday's public holiday.
The call money was traded at 7.5 to 8.5 percent, down from Saturday's nine to 11 percent, dealers said.
